name: Spark-X2.6-4B
archDisplay: 4B-parameter on-device language model with the same architecture as Spark-X2.5-4B (Spark2_5ForCausalLM; layer layout not described on the card); 1,048,576-token context; thinking levels none, low and high
note: iFlytek's open-weight on-device model, released by its SparkLLM (XHToken) team on Hugging Face on Oct 20, 2026 (the GitHub release log dates the global launch Oct 21) and presented again at iFlytek's 1024 Developer Festival on Oct 22 alongside the cloud Spark X2.6. It keeps Spark-X2.5-4B's architecture and gains through post-training; a base checkpoint ships separately. Scores are SparkLLM's with thinking set to high. NOT FILED: BFCL-V4 (71.8; corpus has only bfcl and bfcl-v3, and V4 is a different task version) and AA-LCR v1.1 (67.3; no corpus column). Spark-X2.5-4B (Sep 1, 2026) predates this routine and is not in the corpus.
